Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class TcpServerEventAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.TcpServerEventAdapter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TcpServerEventHandler
    public class TcpServerEventAdapter
extends Object
implements TcpServerEventHandler
    Provides empty implementations of TcpServerEventHandler methods.

    Applications may extend this class and override only the TCP server events they are interested in handling.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    TcpServerEventHandler, TcpServer
